notes: kî takes the complementizer to of the infinitive recasting and the predicate nominal takes the copula be; the explicit hēm is dropped (rules 20, 22, 52).
The suffix on šōṭərāyw is rendered over them, the preposition being the construct relation's own rendering (rule 19).
the elders of the people is rendered arthrously, so the article takes the second the and the construct a supplied one (rule 29).
